label: Qualified business income deduction
description: Form 1040 Line 13a qualified business income deduction; explicitly closed-absent for this milestone's bounded supported class.

published_value.explain: published QBI deduction (closed-absent, always 0 for this bounded class)

computed_zero.explain: Your qualified business income deduction is zero because you said you have none.

guard_inapplicable.explain: This line is computed only when you have no qualified business income, qualified REIT dividends, or publicly traded partnership income. You have not answered that question, or you said you have one.
